svg.title: FutureReady MY system block diagram
svg.text: 1. Browser (React 19, Vite, Tailwind; works at 360 px)
Pure logic in src/lib (tested, no network)
skillMatch.js: Current Skill Match = 100 x sum(I x C) / sum(I); levels Basic 0.5 / Good 0.8 / Expert 1.0; credit only for identical or team-reviewed similar skills
scoring.js: job-outlook score and Moderate / Fast scenario (factors 0.6 / 1.0), effectiveAutomatable blend; never changes the match
topMatches, careerSections, goalView, overviewView (tracked roles), journey / navigation (step locking), cvSkills (keyword CV matching), fieldCheck, replan, skillTrends, research, radar
Screens Explore all roles (#explore) and the preview-free journey: About > Skills > Goal > Matches > Your roles > Study
2. Express 5 API on Node 22 (one app serves dist/ and /api; port 3000)
quick check, 3 h full re-check, logs
4. File storage (JSON, no database server; atomic writes keep the last good file)
ISCO map, SDG tags, role skills,
5. Outside sources, offline pipeline and automation
AI use per task, matched to
embed-emasco > pack vectors; embed-tasks > match-tasks > build-exposure; build-intelligence
eval-cv, eval-skill-search, QA scripts; tests: Vitest 1,019 + Python unittest 264
checks; Refresh data button; admin refresh
models (bge-m3 chosen); not used at run time.
